mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shopping_cart (user_id, voucher_id, quantity, selected, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{voucherId}, #{quantity}, #{selected}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM shopping_cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND voucher_id = #{voucherId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE shopping_cart SET quantity = #{quantity}, selected = #{selected}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE shopping_cart SET selected = #{selected}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM shopping_cart WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT sc.id AS id, sc.voucher_id AS voucherId, sc.quantity AS quantity, sc.selected AS selected, sc.update_time AS updateTime, v.title AS title, v.sub_title AS description, v.image_url AS image, v.pay_value AS price, v.amount AS originalPrice, v.stock AS stock, v.sold_count AS salesCount, m.name AS shopName, CASE WHEN sv.id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isSeckill, sv.start_time AS seckillStartTime, sv.end_time AS seckillEndTime FROM shopping_cart sc LEFT JOIN voucher v ON sc.voucher_id = v.id LEFT JOIN merchant m ON v.merchant_id = m.id LEFT JOIN seckill_voucher sv ON sv.voucher_id = v.id WHERE sc.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY sc.update_time DESC
